#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n;
    string st;
    cin >> n >> st;

    string sb, sb2;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (st[i] == '(') {
            sb.push_back('_');
            ++i;
            while (i < n && st[i] != ')') {
                sb2.push_back(st[i]);
                ++i;
            }
            sb2.push_back('_');
        } else if (i < n) {
            sb.push_back(st[i]);
        }
    }

    // Split sb by '_'
    vector<string> parts;
    string current;
    for (char ch : sb) {
        if (ch == '_') {
            parts.push_back(current);
            current.clear();
        } else {
            current.push_back(ch);
        }
    }
    parts.push_back(current); // last part

    int a1 = 0;
    for (const string& s : parts) {
        a1 = max(a1, (int)s.length());
    }

    // Split sb2 by '_'
    vector<string> parts2;
    current.clear();
    for (char ch : sb2) {
        if (ch == '_') {
            parts2.push_back(current);
            current.clear();
        } else {
            current.push_back(ch);
        }
    }
    parts2.push_back(current);

    int a2 = 0;
    for (const string& s : parts2) {
        if (!s.empty()) ++a2;
    }

    cout << a1 << " " << a2 << endl;

    return 0;
}
